in_sanskrit.name: Solanki
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun-like
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Solanki एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One whose body is sun-like, having the qualities of the sun, and is radiant and powerful.

in_tamil.name: Solanki
in_tamil.long_meaning: Solanki ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One whose body is sun-like, having the qualities of the sun, and is radiant and powerful.

in_telugu.name: Solanki
in_telugu.long_meaning: Solanki ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One whose body is sun-like, having the qualities of the sun, and is radiant and powerful.

in_marathi.name: Solanki
in_marathi.long_meaning: Solanki हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One whose body is sun-like, having the qualities of the sun, and is radiant and powerful.

in_bengali.name: Solanki
in_bengali.long_meaning: Solanki একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One whose body is sun-like, having the qualities of the sun, and is radiant and powerful.
